definition: Perplexity's word for a setting, feature, connector or model that someone has switched off. Use "turned off", "deactivated", "not allowed" instead.
note: Context matters. Accounts: "deactivated" (Perplexity says it about users, 27b98905626c). Buttons and options: "can't be selected" or "dimmed" (103d37587065). Literal values, such as the "Disabled by your organization" label, Enabled/Disabled setting choices, API values and Comet policy values: quote them exactly and explain them as "turned off". The definition replaces "Not allowed" (the optional fix in the draft). 420 snippets on 87 pages, 238 of them on the Comet policies page.

definition: Perplexity's verb for switching off a setting, feature, connector or model. This glossary uses "turn off" instead.
note: Context matters. Accounts: "deactivated" (Perplexity says it about users, 27b98905626c). Buttons and options: "can't be selected" or "dimmed" (103d37587065). Literal values, such as the "Disabled by your organization" label, Enabled/Disabled setting choices, API values and Comet policy values: quote them exactly and explain them as "turned off". The verb is the larger group: 112 snippets on 65 pages.

definition: Perplexity's plans for organizations, sold in two tiers, Enterprise Pro and Enterprise Max, with admin controls over members, data and features.
A shared workspace that keeps your searches, Computer tasks, files, instructions and connected tools together.
note: Space, the old name, has its own row. Two meanings. In the API docs, a Project is "your organization's workspace in the Perplexity API Portal" (bb9c348a5a0b). Consider a separate row, "API Project".

definition: Links to other apps, such as Google Drive, Slack or GitHub, that let Perplexity search or act on what's stored there once you connect your account.
Perplexity's paid plan for individuals, one level above the free plan.
Perplexity's AI agent: instead of only answering, it carries out tasks, such as researching across the web and your apps and creating documents.
Perplexity's web browser, built on Chromium, with AI help built in.
Perplexity's highest-priced plan for individuals, above Pro, with the most access to the newest models and features.
Companies with a Perplexity Enterprise plan. Some admin tools, such as the Audit API, are only open to them.
note: It may be enough to keep only "Enterprise" and "organization".

definition: The standard Enterprise tier: team access to Perplexity, including Computer, with the security controls an IT team needs.
The API for building agents: the model works in steps, calling tools such as web search, and then writes an answer. It replaced Sonar.
The highest Enterprise tier. It has everything in Enterprise Pro, plus extra security features.
Prepaid units that pay for usage. API credits pay for API calls, and Computer credits pay for Computer tasks. The two balances are kept apart.
note: Two meanings. On the API side, 1 credit = $1 (3ec64c21448c). There's already a "Computer credits" row, so consider renaming this one "API credits".

definition: The secret code that proves an API request comes from your account. It's shown only once, when you create it.
The language models, from Perplexity and other companies, that write answers. Which ones you can pick depends on your plan.
The admin area of an Enterprise organization, where admins manage members, roles, connectors and other options for the whole organization.
A set of instructions that teaches Computer how to do one kind of task well.
note: The Agent API also has skills (b37feff313d4). The meaning is close, but the product is different.

definition: The tab on the Plugins page where you browse connectors and skills and add the ones you want.
note: Two meanings. It's also listed as a free-plan feature beside "Collections, sessions" (b21d283aca3d). The glossary's `source_url` (give-it-tools.md) has no snippet with "Discover".

definition: Perplexity's public page of security and compliance documents.
The API that returns a ranked list of web results for a query, not a written answer.
The part of the developer docs that lists every endpoint with its full request and response details.
A mode that reads many sources and writes a detailed report on a complex question.
The website where developers manage their API keys, usage tier and billing for the Perplexity API Platform.
note: Research found API Portal and API Console both point to console.perplexity.ai.

definition: Another name for Comet, Perplexity's browser built on Chromium.
note: Two names for one product. Ask whether to keep only "Comet".

definition: A server that offers tools to AI assistants through MCP (Model Context Protocol, a shared standard for connecting tools). Perplexity runs one, and you can connect others.
Perplexity's public support site, with how-to and troubleshooting articles grouped into collections.
note: Comet has its own: "the Comet Help Center" (f82393937dcd).

definition: The list of models you can choose when calling the Agent API, with their token prices.
A setting that keeps a search out of your saved history and memory.
note: This duplicates "Incognito mode". Lowercase "incognito" also means a browser's own private window (dd62b0d24fc3).

definition: Perplexity's more thorough search for complex questions. Search uses it automatically when your plan includes it.
note: It's no longer a separate toggle (8b1cb31acd13). On the API side, "pro-search" is a retired alias. See section 2.

definition: Files you attach to a question, with the attach button or by drag and drop, so Perplexity can read them. Each plan limits how many you can attach.
note: Capitalization varies. See the question in terms.csv.

definition: An AI agent that takes on ongoing work, such as a project with many steps or regular monitoring.
The AI helper in a side panel next to the main Comet window. It summarizes pages, finds information and carries out tasks.
The old name for a Project. Spaces were renamed Projects.
note: One help page still uses it: "Click the Space or page you wish to delete." (5242b57dfa8e)

definition: Describes a feature that uses AI models to do its work.
note: This describes features rather than naming one. Ask whether it belongs in the glossary.

definition: Perplexity's set of developer APIs (seven of them), which share one API key and one web address, api.perplexity.ai.
People who use Perplexity through their organization's Enterprise Pro or Enterprise Max seat.
Other companies' AI tools, such as chat apps and coding agents, that can connect to Perplexity through MCP.
A memory that runs in the background and builds a working picture of your projects, people, files and unfinished tasks, so Computer can use it.
note: In Research Preview for Max (6ec0708c69d5).

definition: Perplexity Health: a feature for Pro and Max subscribers in the US that uses your medical records and wearable data to answer health questions.
note: The glossary's `source_url` (sdk/error-handling.md) uses "health" to mean "API health", not this feature. Consider "Perplexity Health" as the term.

definition: Same as Incognito: a mode that keeps a search out of your saved history and memory.
note: Consider merging with "Incognito".

definition: Short for role-based access control: admins choose which roles in the organization can use each connector.
note: This is part of a phrase. Consider changing the term to "Role-based access control".

definition: The start page in Perplexity, where you begin a new search or Computer session.

definition: The API that gives you direct access to models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI and others, using one Perplexity API key and one credit balance.
Short for File App Connectors: connectors for Pro subscribers that link a personal file store, such as Google Drive.
note: This is part of a name. It overlaps with "File Connectors" (for Enterprise). Ask whether these are two products or one.

definition: The OpenAI-style format for sending a conversation to a model. The Orchestrator API accepts it.
note: Two meanings. "Sonar Chat Completions" was the older endpoint, and it's now retired: "the legacy Chat Completions endpoint, which is now the Agent API" (1c58f73a48a2).

definition: The name of a Help Center category ("AI Models & Content Generation"), not a feature.
note: Ask whether it belongs in the glossary.

definition: Connectors that let Enterprise Pro and Enterprise Max members search cloud storage, attach cloud files to a question and import files into Projects.
An Agent API tool that searches public professional profiles.
The credits that pay for Computer tasks. They're separate from your subscription and from API credits.

definition: Describes security or controls offered on the Enterprise plans.
note: This is a claim, not a term. It's the same problem as the vague words in section 2.

definition: A quick search type in the Search API, charged per request with no token charges. It's not the same as the Agent API's "fast" effort level.
Short for operating system, such as macOS, Windows or Linux.
note: See the question in terms.csv about where readers first learn what OS means. Ask whether it needs a row.

definition: A way to run Computer on your own Windows or Linux device, so tasks stay local and only reach the cloud with your permission.
A feature that runs your question through several AI models at once and combines their answers into one.
The API that checks the web on a schedule and reports what it finds.
Not a feature: the phrase comes from the help article title "My organization has restricted Comet".
